pinned_comment: Luke 4:19 stops at "the acceptable year of the Lord." The sentence in Isaiah 61:2 goes on: "and the day of vengeance of our God." The Bible does not say why Jesus stopped there. He told the room, "This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears" (Luke 4:21). Later, at the cross, the rulers dared Him with different words but the same challenge: "He saved others; let him save himself" (Luke 23:35). Which part of this story stands out to you most? Read it: Isaiah 61:1-2; Luke 4:16-30; Luke 23:35; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4.
